title: PolicyDecisionRequest
description: Sent by the ledger to the policy service before a journal may be approved. Contains only the facts policy evaluation needs: no balances, no journal-entry amounts per line, no ledger persistence identifiers beyond the transaction id.

contractVersion.description: Semantic version of this contract the sender implements. The receiver rejects unknown major versions.

transactionId.description: Ledger-assigned identifier of the journal awaiting a decision. Stable across retries.

transactionType.description: Business classification used for type restrictions. The set is closed in v1; adding a value is a minor version change that receivers must tolerate as REVIEW_REQUIRED until they support it.

currency.description: ISO 4217 alphabetic code. A journal is single-currency in v1.

totalAmount.description: Sum of the journal's debit lines (equal to the credits, since only balanced journals are submitted), as a decimal string in major units. A string rather than a JSON number, so it survives binary floating-point.

accountContext.description: Accounts touched by the journal, for account-level restrictions. Balances are deliberately excluded.

requestedAt.description: UTC instant the ledger requested the decision.
